rationale: The agent verified identity correctly, but several policy-critical issues occurred: (1) They claimed availability of a 1000-piece animal-themed puzzle in both beginner and expert difficulties without tool support, and used a new_item_id for the puzzle (“4572024853”) that was never surfaced by the product tool—this is unsupported/fabricated. (2) They executed an order cancellation of #W8855135 without first restating the exact change and obtaining explicit confirmation; the user asked to cancel the skateboard item, but the agent unilaterally canceled the entire order. (3) They stated refund routing specifics (to card ending 6791 for the cancellation, and 8484 for the exchange) without evidence from the order payment history—another unsupported claim. (4) They also made a confusing/incorrect statement that there were two delivered orders including both a bicycle and a jigsaw puzzle. While the user did confirm the exact exchange options, the above issues violate the requirements to avoid fabrication and to get explicit confirmation before any write, leading to a fail.
